name: tara-report-runtime-deps
description:
Runtime-only dependencies esbuild cannot bundle (native modules, or modules loaded via createRequire instead of static import — see pdf-generator-node.ts for why). Installed into dist-cli/node_modules by build:cli via `npm install --prefix dist-cli`, so npm resolves the full transitive dependency tree correctly instead of us manually guessing/copying individual folders.

MAINTENANCE: keep these version ranges in sync with the matching entries in the root package.json when bumping either.
